lesson: Never enter a long trade without a protective stop below the opening range; the IMAX long loss proved this.
Avoid shorting high‑volatility earnings‑gap stocks unless you can set a tight stop; the SPOT short loss was a clear example.
Only take trades with conviction >=4 in a risk‑off environment; the blocked SONY and NFLX buys highlighted this rule.
Never re-enter a stock on the same day if it has already broken down below its opening range and VWAP.
Do not execute fallback trades with conviction below 4 just to satisfy cash allocation targets.
Require relative volume (rvol) of at least 1.0 before entering momentum trades in weak market regimes.
Require a minimum 15‑minute relative volume >1.2 before any momentum entry
Place stops at least 0.2% below the opening range or VWAP, not just a fixed dollar amount
Only take trades with conviction >=4; lower‑conviction setups should be skipped
Require rvol > 1.2 before entering any VWAP‑bounce or momentum trade to ensure sufficient intraday interest.
Add a volume confirmation filter for news‑catalyst entries—only trade when 15‑minute volume expands by at least 20% and rvol > 1.2.
Only take opening‑range breakouts when price stays above both the OR and VWAP; otherwise exit early to avoid stalled positions.
